translation: Wear a cloth cap with a drawstring opening, tie the strap tightly, and carefully avoid wind and cold. <ins>Wan Ling Ointment (萬靈膏)</ins> Treats injuries from falls and blows, disperses stasis and toxins, relaxes sinews and quickens blood, stops pain and joins bones as if by magic, and also removes numbness, wind-phlegm, and cold-damp pain and similar conditions. Crane sinew grass (鸛筋草), tou gu cao (透骨草), purple clove root (紫丁香根), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine), pyrite (自然銅, quenched in vinegar seven times), Gua'er dragon's blood (瓜兒血竭), myrrh (沒藥, each one liang), chuanxiong (川芎, eight qian), red peony (赤芍, two liang), half-liang coin (半兩錢, quenched in vinegar, one piece), safflower (紅花, one liang), Sichuan achyranthes (川牛膝), acanthopanax (五加皮), acorus (石菖蒲), Maoshan atractylodes (茅山蒼朮, each five qian), costus root (木香), gentiana (秦艽), cnidium (蛇床子), cinnamon (肉桂), processed Sichuan aconite (川附子, processed), processed pinellia (半夏, processed), dendrobium (石斛), bi xie (萆薢), deer antler (鹿茸, each three qian), tiger shin bone (虎脛骨, one pair), musk (麝香, two qian). Of the above, except for dragon's blood, myrrh, and musk, which are each ground into fine powder and packed separately, there are twenty-three ingredients in total.
